translation.text: You will be like those against whom this word will be a witness: “You have become companions of sinners.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected Charles1906 print has ሰማዕተ, with the printed final vowel retained, and ሱቱፋነ፡ ኮንክሙ in the final clause. Actual primary Dillmann339 gives the witness sense and367 the companion or associate sense. This word will be a witness follows the selected singular future verb and against-them expression; it is not merely hearing a saying. The second-person plural you have become and companions of sinners remain. The colon and quotation marks are translation punctuation linking the statement, not original Ethiopic quotation signs. No reported alternative or1851pronoun replaces the selected source.

translation.text: All the matters of your unrighteousness will be read before the Great Holy One,[a] and your faces will be put to shame. Every work established in unrighteousness will be rejected.[b]

footnotes.text: The selected first verb is in the reading or reciting range: actual primary Dillmann655–656 supports read or recite, not counting. The complete matters-of-your-unrighteousness clause belongs before the Great Holy One, and actual625–626 supports facial shame. The selected all/whole form and its star were rechecked against the other all-form in the same complete unit. No new personal name or active speaker is supplied.

The main Charles1906source retains starred ይገደፍ. Its voice is not silently certified as the English passive. For this final verb only, will be rejected explicitly follows Charles printed202note27, which reports ይትገደፍ for m u, β, and the actual edited1851text onPDF99/printed79, which prints ወይትገደፍ. These are reported or edited readings, not newly inspected manuscripts. The source field is not rewritten from them. Actual primary1205–1206 supports the reject or cast-away range and1289 firmness; established in unrighteousness modifies the work, not the faces. The earlier active He will reject is withdrawn: no active He or new agent is manufactured. This low-confidence critical choice and the main-source uncertainty must remain disclosed.
